Healing Through Innovation

At CytoRegenx, we combine patented laser-activation technology with autologous cell biology to produce next-generation regenerative therapies. Our proprietary Laser Activated Platelet Lysate (LAPL) and Bone Marrow Stromal Cell (BMSC) products are manufactured under strict cGMP standards and delivered to clinicians nationwide.

Our Therapies

LAPL Epidural Injection

Advanced regenerative therapy for lower back pain. Laser-activated platelet lysate delivers high concentrations of neurotrophic factors (NGF, BDNF) for nerve regeneration — without steroids.

Learn more →

BMSC + LAPL Orthopedic

Bone Marrow Stromal Cells combined with LAPL for treatment of disc degeneration, osteoarthritis, and joint disease of the knee, shoulder, and elbow.

Learn more →

DERMATOGEN® Wound Healing

A collagen + LAPL hydrogel for chronic and acute wound care. Accelerates healing of diabetic ulcers, venous leg ulcers, surgical incisions, burns, and trauma wounds.

Learn more →

Why CytoRegenx?

FDA

Registered cGMP compliant cell processing facility

Patented

Low-Level Laser activation of platelets for enhanced cytokine release

Autologous

Derived from the patient's own blood and bone marrow — safe and natural

Validated

Known cytokine profile, verified sterility, and endotoxin-tested

The Science of Laser Activation

Low-Level Laser (LLL) irradiation of platelets triggers exocytosis and the release of a rich cocktail of growth factors — including PDGF, TGF-β, IGF-I, VEGF, FGF, and ATP — at concentrations significantly higher than conventional PRP.

The result is an acellular, injectable product with amplified regenerative, anti-inflammatory, and neurotrophic potential. LAPL can be kept frozen for up to a year without losing potency, and integrates seamlessly into clinical workflows.

item.content:encoded:
About CytoRegenx

Advancing medicine through laser-activated cell therapy

Pioneering Cell-Based Health Therapies

CytoRegenx is dedicated to advancing medicine through innovative cell-based health therapies. We specialize in using laser-activated platelet lysate and cGMP-produced stem cell products to help patients suffering from chronic debilitating diseases, orthopedic injuries, and non-healing wounds.

Our therapies begin with the patient's own biology — blood or bone marrow — and enhance it through our patented laser-activation process. The result is a safe, natural, and concentrated regenerative product with a validated cytokine profile, verified sterility, and proven shelf life.

Our Trailblazing Achievements

As a leader in the field of regenerative medicine, we have achieved several milestones that reflect our commitment to excellence:

  • Patented technology for laser activation of platelets
  • Proprietary combination products — platelet lysate with stem cells for enhanced therapeutic potential
  • FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant cell processing facility
  • Validated products with known cytokine profile, sterility, and endotoxin testing
  • Year-long stability — frozen products maintain potency without degradation

Our Core Therapies

Bone Marrow Stromal Cells (BMSCs)

  • Act as stem cells capable of creating bone, cartilage, and other tissues
  • Differentiate into osteocytes, chondrocytes, adipocytes, and fibroblasts — versatile for orthopedic repair
  • Can differentiate into nucleus pulposus cells and promote healing of spinal discs
  • Promote healing of articular cartilage and spinal disc tissue

Laser Activated Platelet Lysate (LAPL)

  • Made of concentrated platelets with plasma and blood cells removed
  • Rich in growth factors that stimulate tissue regeneration and reduce inflammation
  • Low-Level Laser activation enhances growth factor and ATP release
  • Direct regenerative effects and synergistic action with BMSCs

Explore Our Services

Our innovative cell-based health therapies are designed to deliver the best possible patient outcomes.

Discover Our Services

item.title: Our Services
item.dc:creator: 116154pwpadmin

Our Services

Innovative regenerative medical solutions, delivered from a cGMP-compliant facility

Innovative Regenerative Medical Solutions

At CytoRegenx, we offer cutting-edge regenerative medical solutions designed to enhance the quality of life for patients dealing with chronic pain, orthopedic injuries, and non-healing wounds. Our focus is on leveraging advanced laser-activated cell products in a cGMP-compliant facility to ensure patient safety and superior health outcomes.

Our Three Core Products

LAPL Epidural Injection

Indication: Lower Back Pain / Radicular Pain

A non-invasive regenerative therapy delivered epidurally for radicular pain and lumbar disc-related conditions. Rich in neurotrophic factors (NGF, BDNF), LAPL offers anti-inflammation, pain relief, AND nerve regeneration — capabilities that steroids cannot match.

Learn More

BMSC + LAPL Orthopedic Therapy

Indications: Disc disease (IVDD, bulging, annular tears), osteoarthritis, knee/shoulder/elbow

A proprietary combination product: autologous Bone Marrow Stromal Cells supplemented with cytokine-rich Laser Activated Platelet Lysate. Enhances chondrocyte proliferation, promotes cartilage and disc repair, and decreases pain, inflammation, and cartilage destruction.

Learn More

DERMATOGEN® Wound Healing

Indications: Diabetic foot ulcers, venous leg ulcers, pressure sores, burns, surgical & traumatic wounds

An injectable and topical collagen-LAPL hydrogel. The collagen matrix retains moisture and allows gradual release of LAPL's active ingredients — EGF, FGF, PDGF, VEGF — for accelerated wound closure and minimal scarring.

Learn More

What Makes Our Approach Different

Laser-Activated Cell Products

Precision laser activation enhances cellular effectiveness for improved therapeutic performance — boosting growth factor release and ATP output beyond what standard PRP can achieve.

cGMP-Produced Cell Products

All products are developed under strict current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) to ensure safety, consistency, and high standards of quality — in an FDA-registered facility.

Validated & Tested

Every batch is validated with known cytokine profile, verified sterility, and endotoxin testing — so clinicians and patients get reliable, reproducible results.

The Science Behind Our Therapies

Understanding the transformative power of our regenerative medical solutions is essential for patients and clinicians seeking effective treatments.

item.title: LAPL Epidural Injection for Lower Back Pain
item.dc:creator: 116154pwpadmin
item.content:encoded:
REGENERATIVE THERAPY

Laser Activated Platelet Lysate
for Lower Back Pain

An epidural regenerative therapy that goes beyond steroids

What is CytoRegenx Regenerative Therapy?

  • A non-invasive treatment derived from the patient's own blood — safe, natural, and free from added chemicals.
  • Using our patented technology, platelets are enriched and activated by low-level laser. After activation, the platelet lysate (PL) is produced.
  • The end product — Laser Activated Platelet Lysate (LAPL) — is free from plasma, cells, and cell debris, but contains a high concentration of regenerative cytokines and growth factors.
  • Patients treated with PL epidurals reported significant improvement in pain and subjective improvements through 2-year follow-up (Centeno et al., 2017).

Three Mechanisms of Action

After epidural administration, LAPL's factors exert their effects through three distinct mechanisms:

1. Subsiding Pain

Analgesic cytokines reduce pain signaling at the site of injection.

2. Reducing Inflammation

Anti-inflammatory factors help calm the inflamed nerve root and surrounding tissue.

3. Nerve Regeneration

NGF and BDNF neurotrophic factors drive regeneration of damaged spinal nerves.

The CytoRegenx Unique Approach

  • Low-Level Laser (LLL) activation of platelets enhances the production and release of growth factors and ATP in platelet lysate.
  • LAPL contains exosomes and a high concentration of growth factors that stimulate tissue regeneration and healing at the treated area.
  • LAPL can also reduce inflammation and pain at the site of injection.
  • LAPL contains neurotrophic factors — Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) and Brain Derived Neurotrophic Factor (BDNF) — with direct regenerative effects on spinal nerves.

LAPL vs. Steroid Injection

Steroids have been the standard of care for decades — but they only address inflammation. LAPL offers a fundamentally different therapeutic profile.

Our Patented Technology

  • FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant cell processing facility
  • Validated products with known cytokine profile, verified sterility, and endotoxin level
  • Acellular injectable solution with concentrated cytokines and ATP, customized for epidural administration
  • Product can be kept frozen up to a year without losing potency

Blood Collection & Shipment

  • A 30 mL sample of the patient's whole blood is drawn into a designated PRP collection tube, which we supply.
  • Blood is sent to CytoRegenx the same day in a validated shipper box (also provided).
  • Orange County clinics: a dedicated courier retrieves the specimen directly.
  • Clinics outside Orange County: a prepaid shipping label is issued for seamless pickup through an approved carrier.

Disclaimer: Although the facility and equipment used to produce LAPL are FDA-compliant and our therapy is registered with the FDA, this procedure is not FDA-approved. FDA-registered means that physicians can prescribe and administer this therapy with the patient's consent if they believe it is in the best interest of their patient.

Reference

Centeno C, Markle J, Dodson E, Stemper I, Hyzy M, Williams C, Freeman M. The use of lumbar epidural injection of platelet lysate for treatment of radicular pain. Journal of Experimental Orthopedics (2017) 4:38-49.

item.title: BMSC + LAPL for Orthopedic Use
item.dc:creator: 116154pwpadmin
item.content:encoded:
ORTHOPEDIC REGENERATIVE THERAPY

Bone Marrow Stem Cells + LAPL
for Orthopedic Use

A proprietary technology to improve the efficiency of stem cell therapy

What Are Bone Marrow Stromal Cells?

  • Bone Marrow Stromal Cells (BMSCs) are cells in bone marrow that function as stem cells to create bone, cartilage, and other tissues.
  • BMSCs can differentiate into osteocytes, chondrocytes, adipocytes, and fibroblasts — making them versatile for tissue repair, especially orthopedic use.

What Is Laser Activated Platelet Lysate?

  • Platelet Lysate (PL) is a lysate made of concentrated platelets after removing plasma and other blood cells.
  • Low-Level Laser (LLL) activation of platelets enhances the production and release of growth factors and ATP, boosting regenerative capacity.
  • Laser-Activated PL (LAPL) has synergistic therapeutic effects with BMSCs.

Clinical Applications

BMSCs supplemented with cytokine-rich LAPL offer a promising approach for two major orthopedic categories.

Spine Applications

BMSCs can differentiate into cells resembling nucleus pulposus cells, producing extracellular matrix components and modulating the inflammatory response — an ideal profile for disc disease.

  • Intervertebral Disc Degeneration (IVDD)
  • Disc Bulging
  • Annular Tears

Osteoarthritis & Joint Disease

BMSC-LAPL is enriched in PDGF, IGF-I, TGF-β, PGE2, and ATP. These factors promote cartilage repair, decrease pain and inflammation, and inhibit osteophyte formation.

  • Degenerative Joint Disease (DJD)
  • Knee
  • Shoulder
  • Elbow

Our Technology

  • FDA-registered, cGMP processing facility
  • Validated product with known cell number and viability, defined cytokine profile, and verified sterility and endotoxin levels
  • Concentrated BMSCs in small volume of highly concentrated cytokines and ATP — ideal for orthopedic use
  • Proprietary technology for the preparation of laser-activated platelet lysate
  • Sustaining proliferation and differentiation of BMSCs at the site of injection

Disclaimer: Research into the different applications of bone marrow cells and platelet-derived products is promising and rapidly growing. Although the facility and equipment used to produce BMSC-LAPL are FDA-compliant and our therapy is registered with the FDA, this procedure is considered investigational and has not been officially approved by the FDA. Because BMSCs and LAPL are derived from the patient's own bone marrow and blood, they are not considered drugs. FDA-registered means that physicians can prescribe and administer this therapy with patient consent if they believe it is in the patient's best interest. However, lack of FDA approval means BMSC-LAPL treatments may not be covered by insurance.

item.title: DERMATOGEN® for Wound Healing
item.dc:creator: 116154pwpadmin
item.content:encoded:
REGENERATIVE WOUND HEALING

DERMATOGEN®

Laser Activated Platelet Lysate + Collagen for Wound Healing

What Is Regenerative Wound Healing?

Regenerative wound healing is a procedure that involves advanced therapeutic modalities to promote the body's natural healing process, repair damaged tissues, and restore function in chronic or non-healing wounds.

Wound healing is a complex biological process traditionally divided into four stages: Hemostasis, Inflammation, Proliferation, and Remodeling. These stages ensure the body stops bleeding, prevents infection, and restores the skin's structural integrity.

Why Laser Activated Platelet Lysate?

  • Platelet Lysate is extracted from concentrated platelets after removing red blood cells, white blood cells, cellular fragments, and most plasma.
  • It contains various growth factors that stimulate tissue regeneration and healing at the treated area.
  • Platelet Lysate reduces inflammation and pain, and helps prevent infection at the site of injection.
  • Low-Level Laser activation enhances the production and release of growth factors and ATP, amplifying regenerative properties.
  • LAPL has direct regenerative effects at the administration site, with synergistic therapeutic effects when combined with collagen.

Why Collagen and LAPL?

Collagen is the major matrix protein abundantly present in the skin, playing a critical role in skin structure and elasticity. When collagen and platelet lysate are mixed, they form a hydrogel that sustains LAPL's active ingredients and can be readily applied to wounds.

How DERMATOGEN® Works

LAPL contains highly concentrated cytokines and growth factors — EGF, FGF, PDGF, and VEGF — all of which promote wound healing. It also contains anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic factors to prevent infection, reduce pain, and lower inflammation. Collagen-I forms a gel with LAPL that helps wounds retain moisture and allows gradual absorption of the active ingredients.

The CytoRegenx Unique Approach

DERMATOGEN® is superior to other wound-healing products on several key dimensions:

  • Cytokine-rich Platelet Lysate from the patient's own blood stimulates skin regeneration
  • Proprietary laser activation boosts regenerative capacity beyond standard PRP
  • Injectable and topical dual-delivery approach maximizes skin regeneration and minimizes scar formation
  • Collagen + LAPL combination accelerates the healing process

Wound Types Treated

Chronic Non-Healing Wounds

Often respond especially well to the regenerative wound healing approach:

  • Diabetic foot ulcers
  • Venous leg ulcers
  • Pressure sores (bed sores)

Acute Injuries

Heal more rapidly and with improved tissue quality when treated with regenerative therapy:

  • Surgical incisions
  • Burns
  • Traumatic wounds

Our Technology

  • FDA-registered, cGMP processing facility
  • Validated product with known cell count, defined cytokine profile, and verified sterility and endotoxin level
  • Concentrated cytokines and ATP solution in collagen hydrogel — ideal for wound healing
  • Proprietary technology for laser activation of platelet lysate
  • Sustaining cytokines and LAPL active ingredients at the site of the wound

Disclaimer: Although the facility and equipment used to produce LAPL are FDA-compliant and our therapy is registered with the FDA, this procedure is not FDA-approved. FDA-registered means that physicians can prescribe and administer this therapy with the patient's consent if they believe it is in the best interest of their patient.

item.title: Research & Innovation
item.dc:creator: 116154pwpadmin
item.content:encoded:
Research & Innovation

Advancing regenerative medicine through innovation

Innovation Drives Everything We Do

At CytoRegenx, our work is grounded in advanced cellular science, with a focus on developing laser-activated and cGMP-produced cell products that support the body's natural healing processes.

Our Technology Platform

  • FDA-registered cGMP processing facility
  • Validated products with known cell number and viability, defined cytokine profile, and known sterility and endotoxin level
  • Patient-specific products made of concentrated therapeutic cells in a small volume of highly concentrated cytokines and ATP — ideal for orthopedic use
  • Proprietary laser-activation technology for the preparation of platelet lysate
  • Sustained proliferation and differentiation of therapeutic cells at the site of injection

The Science of Laser Activation

Platelets in their resting state store large quantities of growth factors and bioactive molecules in α-granules. Low-Level Laser (LLL) irradiation — using a plasma-arc light source in the 600–1200 nm near-infrared range — triggers exocytosis, releasing these factors into the surrounding lysate at concentrations significantly higher than mechanical activation alone.

The result is a cytokine cocktail that includes TGF-β, b-FGF, PDGF, VEGF, EGF, IGF-I, and abundant ATP. Our internal data shows BDNF levels in Laser Activated PL significantly exceed those in standard PL — a profile especially valuable for neural regeneration applications.

Published Research

Our therapeutic approach is supported by peer-reviewed literature on platelet lysate epidural injection:

Centeno C, Markle J, Dodson E, Stemper I, Hyzy M, Williams C, Freeman M. The use of lumbar epidural injection of platelet lysate for treatment of radicular pain. Journal of Experimental Orthopedics (2017) 4:38-49.

Patients treated with PL epidurals reported significant improvement in pain and subjective improvements through 2-year follow-up.

For Clinicians

Everything you need to integrate LAPL and BMSC therapies into your practice

Blood Collection & Shipment Protocol

The CytoRegenx workflow is designed to integrate seamlessly into any clinical practice. Collection is straightforward, and we handle logistics end-to-end.

1

Draw Blood Sample

Draw 30 mL of whole blood into the designated PRP collection tube supplied by CytoRegenx.

2

Ship Same Day

Place in the provided validated shipper box and send to CytoRegenx the same day as the draw.

3

Receive Product

We process the sample in our cGMP facility and return the validated LAPL product ready for injection.

Logistics & Shipping

Orange County Clinics

A dedicated courier retrieves the specimen directly from your clinic and transports it to our facility — no shipping paperwork required.

Clinics Nationwide

A prepaid shipping label is issued for seamless pickup and delivery through an approved overnight carrier.

Regulatory Status

The facility and equipment used to produce our products are FDA-compliant, and our therapies are registered with the FDA. These procedures are not FDA-approved. FDA-registered means that physicians can prescribe and administer this therapy with patient consent if they believe it is in the best interest of their patient. Because our products are derived from the patient's own blood or bone marrow, they are not considered drugs.

Lack of FDA approval means that BMSC-LAPL treatments may not be covered by insurance.

Ready to get started?

Our team will walk you through onboarding, collection kits, and clinical protocols.
